title: Notion App — Block Editor
description: Nested vertical slice (slice-of-slices) housing the notion-page-clone block editor as rr's rich-text content engine. Mount <PageEditor pageId> inside <EditorAdapterProvider adapter> — with `{}` it's a working plain-text/markdown block editor (slash menu, markdown triggers, drag, per-block toolbar, undo); host capabilities (data CRUD, selection, comments, AI, databases, mentions, page nav/uploads) light up per optional adapter. Cluster-private shared layer under @notion/* (vendored block/page/database model, uid, inline + page markdown/html export). Pure convex block helpers ship in convex/features/notion (_blocks/_blockOps). 182 tests.
